quests.title: Build the first stack
quests.ask: Step onto the first marked cell and stack it as high as the goal asks, with the robot staying on that cell while it stacks.
quests.nudge: Which line should run many times, and which should run only once?

quests.title: Both stacks, exact heights
quests.ask: Walk on to the second marked cell and build its stack too, so both piles match the goal exactly.
quests.nudge: The two stacks are different heights. Does your second loop know that?
